title: The Last Gravity Revisited
author: Ivo Dravenmoor
blurb: Jude Ravensworth, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
